segments.intent: Identify the most frequently listed skills for the Cincinnati full-time hybrid job
segments.value:
```sql
WITH RECURSIVE split(id, rest, skill) AS (
  SELECT id,
         REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(skills_json, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), '''', '') || ',' AS rest,
         NULL AS skill
  FROM scout_postings
  WHERE LOWER(location_city) = 'cincinnati'
    AND LOWER(location_state) IN ('ohio', 'oh')
    AND LOWER(category) = 'fulltime'
    AND remote = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id,
         SUBSTR(rest, INSTR(rest, ',') + 1),
         TRIM(SUBSTR(rest, 1, INSTR(rest, ',') - 1))
  FROM split
  WHERE INSTR(rest, ',') > 0
)
SELECT skill, COUNT(*) AS job_count
FROM split
WHERE skill IS NOT NULL AND skill <> ''
GROUP BY skill
ORDER BY job_count DESC, skill
```
